sections.title: AI Services for New York Education Organizations
sections.description: Custom AI solutions built for NYC DOE, higher education, EdTech, and workforce development.

blocks.heading: NYC DOE and K-12 Student Success AI
paragraphs: For the New York City Department of Education (1.1 million students across 1,800 schools) and New York's suburban school districts:

Chronic absenteeism prediction: ML identifying students at elevated absenteeism risk in the critical 4–6 weeks before they cross the chronic threshold — particularly important in NYC's recovery from COVID-era attendance disruption.
Early literacy prediction: Reading trajectory prediction from assessment and attendance data in grades K-2, enabling targeted literacy intervention before gaps compound.

High school graduation risk: Multi-year graduation probability modeling for NYC's diverse high school population — incorporating academic, attendance, credit accumulation, and student support signals into counselor-actionable risk tiers.
FERPA-compliant data handling. NYC Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC) standard for EdTech vendors serving NYC schools. New York Education Law §2-d compliance for student data.
Cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Higher Education Student Retention and Analytics
paragraphs: For Columbia, NYU, The New School, Fordham, CUNY, and New York's extensive private university community:
Student retention prediction: ML identifying which students are at risk of withdrawing — enabling proactive academic and financial aid intervention before students make withdrawal decisions.
Course selection optimization: ML recommending optimal course sequences based on academic trajectory, program completion patterns, and graduation requirements.
Research analytics: Faculty research productivity, collaboration network analytics, and grant success prediction for NYU's and Columbia's large research programs.
Cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | FERPA standard

blocks.heading: EdTech Product AI (NYC's Venture Ecosystem)
paragraphs: New York's EdTech investment community — Owl Ventures, Reach Capital, Rethink Education, and the NYC EdTech ecosystem — funds companies building AI-powered education technology products. ClickMasters builds:
Adaptive learning ML: Personalized difficulty and content sequencing algorithms for EdTech products serving NYC's K-12 market.
AI tutoring systems: LLM-powered tutoring assistants that provide step-by-step guidance on math, writing, and content-area questions — with NYC's multilingual student population in mind.
Assessment analytics: Automated short-answer grading, writing feedback AI, and formative assessment analytics for NYC's large testing volume.
NYC EdTech note: FERPA, COPPA for under-13, and New York Education Law §2-d all apply. NYC's student data privacy requirements are among the strictest in the US.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks

blocks.heading: Workforce Development and Adult Education AI
paragraphs: For CUNY's workforce development programs, New York State's workforce development agencies, and corporate learning organizations in NYC:
Skills gap analytics: ML mapping NYC workforce skills gaps from job posting and incumbent skill data — informing CUNY's and NYS's workforce program priorities.
Career pathway AI: Personalized career pathway recommendation for adult learners returning to education — matching their background, constraints, and goals to workforce-aligned programs.
Corporate learning personalization: AI personalizing professional development sequences for NYC's large corporate workforce training programs.
Cost: $40,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

sections.title: NYC Education AI Compliance Requirements
sections.description: Regulatory frameworks embedded in every NYC education AI project.

blocks.heading: New York Education Law §2-d
paragraphs: Among the strictest student data privacy laws in the US — restricts commercial use of student data, requires data privacy officer designation, and imposes contractual requirements on EdTech vendors providing services to New York schools. ClickMasters designs NYC EdTech AI with §2-d requirements and recommends qualified NY education counsel for definitive compliance determinations.

blocks.heading: NYC Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC)
paragraphs: NYC DOE requires EdTech vendors to execute Data Privacy Agreements through the SDPC — ClickMasters provides the technical security and data governance documentation that SDPC vendor review requires.

blocks.heading: FERPA + COPPA
paragraphs: Federal baseline requirements for student data privacy and children's online privacy — ClickMasters designs NYC education AI with both FERPA's educational records protection and COPPA's under-13 online privacy requirements.

blocks.heading: NYC DOE Procurement
paragraphs: Large NYC DOE contracts go through competitive procurement processes with specific requirements for student data security, vendor background, and equity impact assessment. ClickMasters provides required documentation for NYC DOE procurement processes.

sections.title: NYC Education AI Context
sections.description: Unique factors shaping education AI in New York City.

blocks.heading: Multilingual AI Requirements
paragraphs: NYC's 180+ language student population creates AI requirements not encountered anywhere else. Multilingual early literacy assessment, bilingual student success prediction that accounts for dual language program effects, and multilingual parent communication tools are NYC-specific education AI applications.

blocks.heading: NYC's Equity Imperative
paragraphs: NYC's education AI must demonstrate it doesn't create or amplify equity gaps across the city's diverse student population. Algorithmic bias testing across race, ethnicity, English learner status, and disability status is a design requirement for all ClickMasters NYC K-12 AI, not an optional audit.
